---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Grady Woodard"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")
glimpse(births)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- births |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
average_births_by_date <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(average_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(average_births_by_date, aes(
  x = date_of_month,
  y = factor(month, levels = 12:1, labels = month.abb[12:1]),
  fill = average_births
)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 31, by = 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Day of month",
    y = "Month",
    fill = "Mean births"
  )
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12, date_of_month %in% c(20:25, 27:30)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    births_on_december_25 = sum(births[date_of_month == 25]),
    day_of_week = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25][1],
    surrounding_day_average = mean(births[date_of_month != 25]),
    pct_of_baseline =
      births_on_december_25 / surrounding_day_average * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
christmas_births

ggplot(christmas_births, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = day_of_week)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + factor(month) + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)
summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = resid(births_model) / mean(births) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))) |>
  arrange(calendar_date)
calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_dips <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(calendar_date %in% as.Date(c("2001-01-01", "2001-07-04", "2001-12-25"))) |>
  mutate(
    holiday = c("New Year's Day", "Independence Day", "Christmas"),
    label_y = mean_pct_resid + c(5, 5, -5)
  )

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_label(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(label = holiday, y = label_y),
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean residual (% of overall mean)"
  )
```
